info.name: Middleware Third-Party Service
info.description:
Complete API collection for the Middleware Third-Party Service.

## URL Variables
- `{{kongUrl}}` — through API Gateway (Kong). Includes the `/middleware-third-party` prefix. **Use this for everything.**
  - Local:  `http://localhost:8000/middleware-third-party`
  - Remote: `http://46.62.226.94:8000/middleware-third-party`
- `{{kongUrl}}` — direct to the service container (`localhost:8093`). Only works from inside the docker network or `localhost` shell.

> Calling Kong without the `/middleware-third-party` prefix returns `no Route matched with those values`.

## Execute API Authentication
Execution endpoints use client secretKey via X-Secret-Key header, or the `/simple` endpoint (no auth) for internal service-to-service calls.

## Cost Tracking
Each API in the catalog has a `costPerCall` price. Every execution snapshots the price into `client_request_*` so admin price changes never alter historical bills.

- Send `X-Customer-Id`, `X-Application-Id`, `X-Context-Type` (ONBOARDING / APPLICATION) on execute calls to attribute cost.
- Admin can update prices via `PATCH /provider-apis/{id}/cost`.
- Reports under `/cost-reports/**` aggregate by customer / application / API / service (requires admin JWT).

## Setup Flow
1. Create Providers
2. Create Provider APIs
3. Configure Environment
4. Create Clients
5. Grant Access
6. Execute APIs

item.name: Cost Tracking
item.description:
Admin-managed per-API cost catalog + cost reports per customer / application / onboarding.

Use {{adminToken}} (admin or super_admin JWT).

## Snapshot pricing
Every execution stores the current `costPerCall` onto the request row. Admin price changes affect only future calls — historical bills are immutable.

item.name: Admin: Update Cost by API Code

request.description: Update the per-call price of an API by its code (e.g. SAFEWATCH_SCAN_SESSION). Admin only.

item.name: Admin: Update Cost by API ID

request.description: Update the per-call price of an API by its UUID. Admin only.

Overall third-party cost incurred for one customer.

Response includes:
- `totals`: call_count + total_cost + currency
- `byContextType`: ONBOARDING vs APPLICATION breakdown
- `byApplication`: per-application drilldown
- `byApi`: per-API drilldown
Itemised list of every middleware call for one loan application, with timestamp, status, and snapshotted cost.
Total cost incurred during the ONBOARDING context for a customer (context_type='ONBOARDING').
Customers ranked by total third-party API spend (descending).
Total cost grouped by API code (which APIs are draining the most money).
Total cost grouped by `caller_service` (lending-service, risk-service, customer-service, ...).
